metadata.name: stablecoin-uxd-style-collateral-cascade
metadata.description: UXD-style stablecoin collateral-cascade + redemption-run pressure replay. Scheduled hedge-loss at tick 3 shrinks delegated collateral; panic redemption demand at tick 4 exceeds the reserve buffer and lands three accounts on the pending-redemption queue; tick 5 partial claim settles only the reserve-covered position. Historical inspiration: the November 2022 UXD delta-neutral backing gap after the Mango exploit wiped the hedge leg. Honest boundary: single-program pressure replay against the shipped minimal stablecoin, not a literal UXD codebase reconstruction and not a live hedge-venue integration.
metadata.source: UXD Protocol post-incident disclosures, November 2022 (Mango exploit contagion)
